issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'Ngài đáp' (He answered) is an addition/mistranslation of the Greek structure. The Greek text 'ο δε προς αυτους εφημεις λεγετε οτι εγω ειμι' translates to 'but to them [He] said, "You say that I am"'. The Vietnamese phrasing makes it sound like He is answering a question about His identity, whereas the Greek indicates He is repeating their own statement back to them.
